# KULT Salon

> Premium unisex luxury salon in Mumbai offering hair, colour, skin, nails and bridal services.

KULT is a Bandra-based salon focused on considered, precise, editorial-quality beauty work. The site presents services, artists, portfolio, loyalty programme, and online booking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand introduction and service overview.
- [Services](/services): Menu of hair, colour, skin, nails and bridal services with pricing.
- [Team](/team): Profiles of KULT stylists and specialists.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Portfolio of recent hair, colour, bridal, skin and nail work.
- [Loyalty](/loyalty): KULT Rewards programme details and tiers.
- [Contact](/contact): Location, hours, and contact form.
- [Book](/book): Multi-step appointment booking.
